# Contract: security-threat-model

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: engineering. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Trust boundaries, STRIDE, risk ranking, local proofs and regression tests, on code the user owns only.

## Use it for
- "threat model my app"
- "is this secure"

## Not for
- test someone else's site or production (refused)

## Accepted inputs
An owned repo running locally with throwaway data.

## Deliverables
THREAT_MODEL.md, failing-then-passing tests.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local dev server only; never production or third parties.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Scope (ask, one question at a time)
2. Map the surface from the code
3. Draw the data flow
4. Find and rank threats
5. Prove, fix, keep the test
6. Write THREAT_MODEL.md

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Scope and what would hurt

## Quality checks
- Proof test fails on vulnerable code, passes on fixed, controls pass

## Common failures
- Heuristic scanners miss things and flag false positives

## Limitations
- Cannot certify safety

## Reproducible example
examples/invoice-api vulnerable vs fixed with 18 tests.
